posts.name: Pausr
posts.tagline: Your body wasn't built to sit at a screen all day
posts.description: Pausr is a menu bar Mac app that runs three research-timed breaks: 20s looking away every 20 min, 90s on your feet, one real 15-minute break. Small nudges in between remind you to blink and sit up straight, without interrupting anything. It knows when to stay quiet: meetings, calls, screen sharing and fullscreen games hold every break until you're free, each with a 30-second heads-up. No account, no server: your stats stay on your Mac. Free for 7 days.

posts.name: Droptick
posts.tagline: One ad slot a week. Opens at €10k, falls until someone buys
posts.description: Droptick sells one promoted link a week: the price opens at €10,000 every Monday 08:00 Berlin and falls along a hidden curve until someone takes it. Monday it resets. The mechanic is not new This is a descending auction — the price starts above what anyone will pay and comes down until a buyer stops it. Dutch flower markets have sold this way for over a century: the clock at Aalsmeer runs down, and the first buyer to press the button gets the lot.

posts.name: Hybrid RAG
posts.tagline: Zero-cloud SQLite FTS5 RAG engine & GitHub Action
posts.description: Context-grounded repository AI assistant using Hybrid RAG (Okapi BM25 + Dense Semantic Vector Search + Reciprocal Rank Fusion k=60). Features markdown AST-aware chunking for deterministic line-span citations ([file#L-L]), zero-dependency @vercel/ncc bundling, and zero-cloud SQLite FTS5 execution.

posts.name: Teika
posts.tagline: Accurate, fast, and private speech-to-text notes for iOS.
posts.description: A lot of products start by wanting to scratch your own itch. Mine was simple: while cycling or driving, I’d often want to jot something down but Siri is terrible at it. So I built Teika. Press a button, talk for as long as you want, and Teika transcribes it instantly and copies the text straight to your clipboard. It runs entirely on-device, so it’s fast, accurate, private, and open-source.

posts.name: DraftCareer
posts.tagline: Search jobs, tailor your resume to each one, apply — free
posts.description: DraftCareer is a resume and cover letter builder that doesn't stop at the PDF. Search real jobs across 22 countries, tailor your resume and cover letter to a listing with one click, and apply — all from one profile. 46 templates, built around real roles — clean ATS-safe single-column designs, and bold two-column layouts for a human reviewer. AI writing-assist helps you draft summaries, bullet points, and cover letters, but always leaves you to review and edit. Free to start. No watermark, ever.

posts.name: Krionex
posts.tagline: “Deploy, verify & manage smart contracts across EVM chains.”
posts.description: Krionex is a workspace to deploy, verify, and manage smart contracts across seven EVM chains, including BNB Chain. Use guided templates for ERC20, ERC721, and ERC1155, or write custom contract code in the built-in editor. A preflight check estimates gas cost and deployability before you spend anything. After deployment, manage contracts with minting, burning, role transfers, royalties, and ownership transfer. Fully non-custodial: you connect your own wallet and sign every action.
